plan.title: Define deterministic surface extraction contracts and fixtures

criteria.description: Equivalent extraction output ordering produces identical canonical bytes and digest.
Meaningful values, array order, item membership and extractor identity affect the digest without binding it to unrelated input changes.
Failed, missing, malformed, ambiguous and oversized output cannot produce a valid empty snapshot.

limitations: Protocol and in-memory canonicalization only; process execution, packs, baseline storage, diff and approval belong to later tasks.
Extractors own semantic filtering and must version policy changes; no generic volatile-field removal or language AST support.
Exact JSON number spelling and array order are preserved; this format is not RFC 8785.
